newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway shares hit 10th consecutive closing high.
newsitem.headline: Norway shares hit 10th consecutive closing high.

text.p: Norwegian shares edged just 0.7 percent higher on Thursday but it was enough to score a record close for the 10th consecutive session.
The Total index finished on 920.24 points in heavy trade worth 980 billion crowns.
Dealers said the market continued to be buoyed by Wall Street gains, low interest rates and good liquidity.

"The market is solid and driven by liquidity," said one. "I believe the market will stay on a high level until New Years unless something special happens. But we could obviously see some corrections in the meantime."
Blue chip shares such as Norsk Hydro and Kvaerner continued to rise.

Norsk Hydro, Norway's largest listed company and with a 20 percent weighting on the Total index, rose 1.13 percent to 314.50 crowns. Offshore engineering and construction group Kvaerner A share was up 0.60 percent at 253.50 crowns.

Engineering and offshore group Aker's A share finished 0.70 percent higher at 143 crowns minutes before Aker shareholders voted overwhelmingly in favour of merging the company with investment group RGI.
